3592.title: Repository leaf validation blocks worktree paths
3592.rootCauseOneLine: The ASCII-only repository leaf validator rejects spaces and non-ASCII names before worktree creation.
3592.proposedFix: Separate destination leaf generation from source validity while preserving path-safety checks.
3592.caveats: Focused production path test only; no live task dispatch or provider session. No PR because the fix touches path-safety validation, outside the simple-fix rule.
